subject.title: [Feature]: Harden Control UI Lit lifecycle boundaries

question: Should this Control UI lifecycle hardening land as one coordinated modernization slice, or be split into smaller PRs by lifecycle seam?
rationale: The source evidence supports the problem, but the protected maintainer label and multi-surface UI refactor require owner intent on scope, sequencing, and proof before automation should act.

options.title: Split by lifecycle seam
options.body: Create separate PRs for shared host/i18n, external subscriptions, router pending/not-found state, and chat post-render/persistence teardown.

options.title: Land one coordinated slice
options.body: Allow a single broader refactor if the owner wants one review package and it includes broad Control UI regression and browser proof.

options.title: Fix only proven bugs
options.body: Defer shared abstractions and repair only lifecycle races that have focused reproduction or test evidence.

recommendation.title: Split by lifecycle seam
recommendation.body: Create separate PRs for shared host/i18n, external subscriptions, router pending/not-found state, and chat post-render/persistence teardown.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI shell/sidebar and composer-state work plus the maintainer-requested issue context make this the clearest decision route.
